verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents a session supervisor for background workers and agent runtimes that must outlive an SDK call. It also documents persistent sandboxes that preserve the root filesystem across checkpoints, pause between tasks and resume the same sandbox, with auto_resume on inbound access. Per-second compute billing with no one-hour minimum and storage-only charges while paused make multi-hour or multi-day work practical. Missing for 10: no documented maximum session lifetime or idle-timeout policy confirming continuous runs of hours or days; process-state preservation across pause is only experimental; no independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running sessions.
